## Orientation

Territory: store constraint records only (primary checkout `.artifacts`). Create `dashboard-human-gate-writes` and retire the three `dashboard-read-only*` constraints. No code tree edits.

Concurrency: parallel with `approval-contract` (contract files in worktree) — no collision.

Operational: parent session applies store writes (single-writer). Subagent drafts the statement/Basis and returns evidence; parent executes create + retire. Or parent executes Approach directly when store-only.

## Requirements

R7: Supersede stale active `dashboard-read-only*` constraints with one constraint describing the allowed write set: human gates only, via CLI, with a recorded decision.

## Design invariants

- Allowed dashboard writes are exactly the human-gate set described by the new constraint.

## Decisions

- dashboard-approvals-scope: Full #8: detail, confirm, notes, approve/reject, constraint cleanup
